about: Shared vectors of the settings contract (ui/Grassfield/Ui/SettingsContract.js, generated from config/schema/grassfield.schema.json): what a reader makes of a stored value. `stored` is the JSON value in grassfield.json (`absent` true = the key is missing), `read` what every reader uses (a number out of range is clamped, an integer rounded first, any other invalid value is the schema default; `default` true = the key's default), `valid` whether a write of that value is accepted, `shell` C3 marks a vector the shell's SettingsStore still reads differently (type coercion, list filtering, colour case; slice C3 fixes them; tests/shell/settings_vectors expects the difference and fails when it is gone). Read by tests/unit/tst_settingscontract.qml; the shell's SettingsStore can read the same file once it uses the contract (GF-084 C3).
